title: Real form of binary decoding
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2$ be a function. Encode each bit as a sign and transport $f$ to the sign cube using the coordinatewise bit-to-sign bijection. Then the real-valued version of the decoded sign-valued function equals the real sign encoding of $f$ transported from the binary cube to the sign cube.
hypotheses_covered: A function from the binary $n$-cube to $\mathbb F_2$
